UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user profile within the AquaGuard application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user profile.

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was last updated.

WaterConsumptionData.title: WaterConsumptionData
WaterConsumptionData.description: Represents water consumption data recorded by the ESP32 sensor.

id.description: Unique identifier for the water consumption data entry.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the water consumption data was recorded.

flowRate.description: Water flow rate measured by the sensor (e.g., liters per minute).

totalConsumption.description: Total water consumption since the last reset (e.g., liters).

ValveControlLog.title: ValveControlLog
ValveControlLog.description: Represents a log of valve control actions (open/close) performed by the user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the valve control log entry.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the valve control action was performed.

action.description: The action performed on the valve (e.g., 'open', 'close').

reason.description: The reason for the valve control action (e.g., 'manual', 'leak detected').

Alert.title: Alert
Alert.description: Represents an alert or notification sent to the user regarding water consumption.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the alert was generated.

message.description: The message content of the alert.

isRead.description: Indicates whether the alert has been read by the user.

ConservationTip.title: ConservationTip
ConservationTip.description: Represents a water conservation tip tailored to the user's consumption patterns.

id.description: Unique identifier for the conservation tip.

rationale.description: Explanation of why the tip is relevant to the user's consumption patterns.

effectivenessScore.description: A score indicating the potential effectiveness of the tip for the user.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure is designed to ensure Authorization Independence and support the QAPs, focusing on user-owned data and minimizing `get()` calls in security rules.  Each collection uses path-based ownership for simple and secure access control. Data is structured under the `users/{userId}` path to represent a `User 1:N Entity` relationship.

*   **Authorization Independence:** Achieved by using path-based ownership (`/users/{userId}/...`).  Each document implicitly inherits the authorization context from its parent user document. No `get()` calls are needed to verify ownership.
*   **QAPs Support:** The structure supports secure `list` operations because access control is determined by the path.  Listing data under `/users/{userId}/...` is secure, as rules can easily verify `request.auth.uid == userId`.
*   **Global Roles (DBAC):** Not applicable as there are no global roles required.
*   **Explicit State Modeling:** Enforces a dedicated `status` field for state management. 

Each entity follows a consistent naming convention and authorization pattern.
